BiblicalUsage: Chezib is a place in Palestine, named once, in Genesis 38:5, where Judah's wife bore Shelah while the family story was turning dark. The verse gives no description of the town, only the fact that Shelah was born there.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even a one-verse place belongs on the map, because God records where His promises travel, not only where they arrive.
